def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:

    features = pd.DataFrame(index=entity_list)

        'n_orders', 'n_items', 'total_sales', 'avg_price', 'std_price',
        'avg_freight', 'std_freight', 'n_sellers', 'days_since_first',
        'days_since_last', 'lifetime_days', 'has_sales',
        'avg_review_score', 'std_review_score', 'n_reviews',
        'n_orders_last_30', 'n_orders_last_60', 'n_orders_last_90',
        'n_orders_last_180', 'n_orders_last_365',
        'sales_last_30', 'sales_last_90',
        'trend_30_90', 'recency_ratio',
        'avg_review_last_90', 'n_reviews_last_90',
        'share_reviews_1_2', 'share_reviews_4_5',
        'days_since_last_review', 'avg_installments', 'avg_payment_value',
        'share_credit_card', 'share_boleto', 'share_voucher',
        'delivered_orders', 'canceled_orders', 'avg_delivery_delay',
        'avg_estimated_delivery_days', 'n_distinct_categories_like_price',
        'price_vs_lifetime_avg', 'orders_per_active_day',
        'freight_ratio', 'n_items_per_order'
    ]
    for f in feature_names:
        features[f] = 0.0

    order_items = db['order_items']
    orders = db['orders']
    reviews = db['reviews']
    payments = db['payments']

    # --- Только события, произошедшие до seed_time (без утечки из будущего) ---
    mask = (order_items['product_id'].isin(entity_list)) & (order_items['ts'] <= seed_time)
    items = order_items.loc[mask].copy()

    # Заказы: используем только строки, существующие на момент seed_time
    # (покупка совершена до seed_time; статусы/даты доставки могли ещё не появиться,
    #  поэтому учитываем их только если они не позже seed_time)
    orders_hist = orders[orders['order_purchase_timestamp'] <= seed_time].copy()
    # дата доставки засчитываем только если она уже наступила к seed_time
    delivered_mask = orders_hist['order_delivered_customer_date'].notna() & \
                     (orders_hist['order_delivered_customer_date'] <= seed_time)
    orders_hist['is_delivered'] = delivered_mask.astype(int)
    orders_hist['is_canceled'] = (orders_hist['order_status'].isin(['canceled', 'unavailable'])).astype(int)

    if not items.empty:
        # ---- Базовые агрегаты ----
        agg = items.groupby('product_id').agg(
            n_orders=('order_id', 'nunique'),
            n_items=('price', 'size'),
            total_sales=('price', 'sum'),
            avg_price=('price', 'mean'),
            std_price=('price', 'std'),
            avg_freight=('freight_value', 'mean'),
            std_freight=('freight_value', 'std'),
            n_sellers=('seller_id', 'nunique'),
            first_purchase=('ts', 'min'),
            last_purchase=('ts', 'max')
        )
        agg['days_since_first'] = (seed_time - agg['first_purchase']).dt.days
        agg['days_since_last'] = (seed_time - agg['last_purchase']).dt.days
        agg['lifetime_days'] = (agg['last_purchase'] - agg['first_purchase']).dt.days
        agg['has_sales'] = 1
        agg['n_items_per_order'] = agg['n_items'] / agg['n_orders'].replace(0, np.nan)
        agg['orders_per_active_day'] = agg['n_orders'] / (agg['lifetime_days'] + 1.0)
        agg['freight_ratio'] = agg['avg_freight'] / agg['avg_price'].replace(0, np.nan)

        agg = agg.fillna(0.0)
        base_cols = ['n_orders', 'n_items', 'total_sales', 'avg_price', 'std_price',
                     'avg_freight', 'std_freight', 'n_sellers', 'days_since_first',
                     'days_since_last', 'lifetime_days', 'has_sales',
                     'n_items_per_order', 'orders_per_active_day', 'freight_ratio']
        for col in base_cols:
            features.loc[agg.index, col] = agg[col].values

        # ---- Периодные агрегаты ----
        for period in [30, 60, 90, 180, 365]:
            cutoff = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=period)
            period_items = items[items['ts'] >= cutoff]
            if not period_items.empty:
                oc = period_items.groupby('product_id')['order_id'].nunique()
                sc = period_items.groupby('product_id')['price'].sum()
                features.loc[oc.index, f'n_orders_last_{period}'] = oc
                if period in (30, 90):
                    features.loc[sc.index, f'sales_last_{period}'] = sc

        # тренд: продажи за последние 30 дней против предыдущих 60
        c30 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=30)
        c90 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)
        s30 = items[items['ts'] >= c30].groupby('product_id')['price'].sum()
        s_prev = items[(items['ts'] >= c90) & (items['ts'] < c30)].groupby('product_id')['price'].sum()
        trend = (s30 - s_prev) / (s_prev + s30 + 1.0)
        features.loc[trend.index, 'trend_30_90'] = trend

        rec = 1.0 / (1.0 + agg['days_since_last'])
        features.loc[agg.index, 'recency_ratio'] = rec

        # ---- Отзывы (только те, что уже созданы к seed_time) ----
        rev = reviews[reviews['review_creation_date'] <= seed_time].copy()
        if not rev.empty:
            uniq_oi = items[['product_id', 'order_id']].drop_duplicates()
            rev_merged = uniq_oi.merge(
                rev[['order_id', 'review_score', 'review_creation_date']],
                on='order_id', how='inner'
            )
            if not rev_merged.empty:
                rev_agg = rev_merged.groupby('product_id').agg(
                    avg_review_score=('review_score', 'mean'),
                    std_review_score=('review_score', 'std'),
                    n_reviews=('review_score', 'count'),
                    last_review=('review_creation_date', 'max')
                )
                rev_agg['days_since_last_review'] = (seed_time - rev_agg['last_review']).dt.days
                rev_agg['share_reviews_1_2'] = rev_merged[rev_merged['review_score'] <= 2] \
                    .groupby('product_id').size() / rev_agg['n_reviews']
                rev_agg['share_reviews_4_5'] = rev_merged[rev_merged['review_score'] >= 4] \
                    .groupby('product_id').size() / rev_agg['n_reviews']
                rev_agg = rev_agg.fillna(0.0)
                rev_cols = ['avg_review_score', 'std_review_score', 'n_reviews',
                            'days_since_last_review', 'share_reviews_1_2', 'share_reviews_4_5']
                for col in rev_cols:
                    features.loc[rev_agg.index, col] = rev_agg[col].values

                # отзывы за последние 90 дней
                rev90 = rev_merged[rev_merged['review_creation_date'] >= seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)]
                if not rev90.empty:
                    r90 = rev90.groupby('product_id').agg(
                        avg_review_last_90=('review_score', 'mean'),
                        n_reviews_last_90=('review_score', 'count')
                    )
                    for col in ['avg_review_last_90', 'n_reviews_last_90']:
                        features.loc[r90.index, col] = r90[col]

                pay[['order_id', 'payment_installments', 'payment_value', 'payment_type']],
                on='order_id', how='inner'
            )
            if not pay_merged.empty:
                pay_agg = pay_merged.groupby('product_id').agg(
                    avg_installments=('payment_installments', 'mean'),
                    avg_payment_value=('payment_value', 'mean')
                )
                n_pay = pay_merged.groupby('product_id').size()
                for ptype, col in [('credit_card', 'share_credit_card'),
                                   ('boleto', 'share_boleto'),
                                   ('voucher', 'share_voucher')]:
                    cnt = pay_merged[pay_merged['payment_type'] == ptype] \
                        .groupby('product_id').size()
                    features.loc[cnt.index, col] = (cnt / n_pay[cnt.index]).fillna(0.0)
                for col in ['avg_installments', 'avg_payment_value']:
                    features.loc[pay_agg.index, col] = pay_agg[col]

        # ---- Статусы заказов (только известные к seed_time) ----
        ord_info = orders_hist[['order_id', 'is_delivered', 'is_canceled',

        oi_uniq = items[['product_id', 'order_id']].drop_duplicates()
        oi_ord = oi_uniq.merge(ord_info, on='order_id', how='left')
        oi_ord['is_delivered'] = oi_ord['is_delivered'].fillna(0)
        oi_ord['is_canceled'] = oi_ord['is_canceled'].fillna(0)
        st = oi_ord.groupby('product_id').agg(
            delivered_orders=('is_delivered', 'sum'),
            canceled_orders=('is_canceled', 'sum'),
            n_orders_all=('order_id', 'nunique')
        )
        st['delivered_orders'] = st['delivered_orders'] / st['n_orders_all'].replace(0, np.nan)
        st['canceled_orders'] = st['canceled_orders'] / st['n_orders_all'].replace(0, np.nan)

        deliv = oi_ord[oi_ord['is_delivered'] == 1].copy()

            delay = (deliv['order_delivered_customer_date'] -

            deliv['delivery_delay'] = delay
            dmean = deliv.groupby('product_id')['delivery_delay'].mean()
            features.loc[dmean.index, 'avg_delivery_delay'] = dmean
        for col in ['delivered_orders', 'canceled_orders']:
            features.loc[st.index, col] = st[col].fillna(0.0)

        # ---- Цена относительно исторической средней ----
        c90 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)
        p90 = items[items['ts'] >= c90].groupby('product_id')['price'].mean()
        ratio = (p90 / agg['avg_price']).fillna(1.0)
        features.loc[ratio.index, 'price_vs_lifetime_avg'] = ratio

    features = features.apply(pd.to_numeric, errors='coerce')
    features = features.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0.0)
    features = features.reindex(entity_list)
    features = features.fillna(0.0)
    return features
